description_en: Deletes an idle zone (built-in authoritative domain name)
description_zh: 调用DeleteZone删除一个空闲的内置权威域名（Zone）
name: DeleteZone

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the zone.

You must dissociate a built-in authoritative domain name from its scope before you delete it
parameters.help_zh:
Zone ID，Zone的唯一识别码。

对于已配置域名生效范围的内置权威域名，必须先将其与域名生效范围解除关联，然后才能删除
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The token must contain only ASCII characters and be no more than 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

ZoneId.description_en: The unique ID of the zone
